verdict.rationale: Ultrametric's `init` command only previews and writes its own prebuilt Ultrametric SKILL.md into the Codex and Claude Code skill folders. Nothing in the evidence documents a template or guide for writing a new skill with name and description frontmatter. Installing a vendor skill is an adjacent feature, not skill authoring, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can author a new skill from a documented template — a SKILL.md with name and description frontmatter — without reverse-engineering existing skills
